infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SafeSathi needs your location to trigger SOS with your position and to recommend safer routes.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: SafeSathi watches for danger signals in the background, which requires location access even when the app isn't open.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SafeSathi listens for emergency keywords like "Help" or "Bachao" to trigger SOS automatically.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SafeSathi captures photo evidence during an active SOS.
